jobs.occupation: Staff Mixed-Signals Verification Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Are you interested in new technologies and future-oriented projects in the field of chip design?
Then Photeon is the right choice!

As one of the market leaders for turnkey solutions for our broad portfolio of customers, Photeon offers possibility to work on many interesting and highly complex products for Automotive, Industrial, Medical and many other markets. We offer a dynamic, exciting, and friendly environment, as well as many possibilities for your further development in the direction that suits you the best. 

We invite you to be a part of our family and be a driver of developing your knowledge, skills, and experience. 1 Staff Mixed-Signals Verification Engineer (m/f/x) Your Role:

 * Working on Verification of Analog and Mixed-Signal (AMS) products

 * Own system-level / full-chip verification

 * Define and refine verification concepts, architecture and plans

 * Drive model-based verification (RNM, abstraction) and ensure model - schematic consistency

 * Architect and oversee development of testbenches and stimuli generation

 * Drive integration across Analog and Digital domains (mixed-signal / DMS environments)

 * Run simulations, analyze results and lead verification reviews

 * Mentor engineers and review verification work

Your Profile:

 * Bachelor or Master degree or equivalent in electrical engineering or physics

 * ~8+ years experience in analog/mixed-signal verification

 * Strong SystemVerilog and advanced modeling (RNM / Verilog-AMS) skills

 * Proven experience in system-level verification

 * Ability to translate requirements into verification strategies

 * Experience with mixed-signal system integration (UVM/DMS beneficial)

 * Strong collaboration across multiple domains

 * Knowledge of semiconductor physics and semiconductor technologies

 * Good verbal and written English skills, German is an advantage

What We Offer:

 * Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and a talented team.

 * Personal development and individual training plans.

 * Innovative products and business environment.

 * Flexible working hours.

 * Friendly and supportive environment.

 * Exciting, varied work in a growing and internationally active company.

 * Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing support.

 * Modern office spaces.

 * Team building events.

 * Competitive compensation well above the relevant collective agreement (minimum monthly gross salary according to collective agreement "IT" ST1 Einstiegsstufe EUR 3.267; ST1 Regelstufe EUR 3.954; ST2 Einstiegsstufe EUR 4.061; ST2 Regelstufe EUR 4.611).

Are you ready to shape the future of semiconductor technology aimed at enabling solutions for a better life? We look forward to receiving your application at recruiting@photeon.com.

Location: Dornbirn, Austria

jobs.occupation: Mechatronics Development Engineer (m/f/d) (Application-Engineer/-Manager/in)
jobs.description: About EASEEASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.The roleWith the LU 20, our first active exoskeleton is going into series production and gaining its first experience with customers in logistics and manufacturing. Your job is to optimise the LU 20's mechanics with what we learn in the field and take the next generation to series readiness, so that heavy physical work becomes easier and healthier for the people in warehouses and production plants.What you'll do- Further develop the mechanics of the LU 20 while keeping the complete system in view- Turn customer deployments and tests on our endurance rigs into concrete improvements- Design new features in SolidWorks and validate them with strength analyses (FEA)- Take features from prototype to series, incl. DFM, manufacturing processes and CE testing- Integrate sensors and electronics into the mechanical design and shape human-machine interaction- Work closely with our electronics, embedded software and physical AI teamsWhat you bring- Degree in mechatronics, mechanical engineering or similar, with 1 to 3 years of experience in product development; graduates with relevant projects are welcome- Very good knowledge of mechanics and mechanical design in a CAD tool (e.g. SolidWorks, Creo or Siemens NX)- Understanding of design for manufacturing and strength verification (e.g. FEA, DFM or tolerance analysis)- Business-fluent German or English; both languages are a plus- The drive to take ownership of a product in series production and make a real impact as a teamNice to have- Experience in lightweight design and with electronics or microcontrollers; ideally you have taken a product through CE testing or to market- A background in ergonomics, biomechanics, sports science or physiotherapy, as our exoskeleton works directly on the human bodyDon't tick every box? Apply anyway. What you have built matters more than a perfect match.What we offer- Real ownership of a product in series production, with direct feedback from the field- The chance to shape the next generation of the LU 20 from the very start- Short iteration cycles from CAD to testing on our endurance rigs- Flexible hours, on-site in Munich, mobility benefit- Budget for conferences and further training
